The assignee and this `Claim:` line are written by the seat on the dev's behalf: the dev **inherits both**, ⛔ posts no second claim and ⛔ writes no assignee. `needs:contract-review` is hung on the card in the same write as the claim, because this seat declares `Clause-②: yes` — see §4.

⚠️ Selected because the two cards ahead of it are out: **#17329** stays fenced on `serve.ts` + `dev.ts` (open #17725), and **#17536** was sent back to triage this round (`5644235398`) over a direction question its own filer flagged 「before dispatch」 and neither triage pass answered. ⛔ Neither is a grading of this card.

---

## 1. The ruling — direction is settled; two of three routes are explicitly refused

Triage ruled at [`5643017415`](https://github.com/objectstack-ai/objectstack/issues/17672#issuecomment-5643017415). Quoted, and these are the fence:

> **① 方向 —— 让那条唯一的规则可达,门答 `400 VALIDATION_ERROR`。** 即卡里的路线 1:把 `refuseRepeatedQueryParams` / `repeatedQueryParamMessage` 从 `@objectstack/rest` 的入口导出(或给该模块一个 subpath),让 dispatcher 的 domain 调用**那一份实现**。

> ⛔ **否决路线 3**(裁定本门合法地答一个不同的状态码):它要推翻的是**同条件同路由**的已落地先例,而卡里没有给出任何推翻它的理由。

> ⛔ **否决路线 2**(把拒收上移到 `packages/rest` 的 ingress 层):… Route and surface ownership 规则**明文**规定闭合集转换**按车道逐条进行、绝不作为一次扫荡**。用一个状态码缺陷去触发一次层归属变更,比例失当。

> **② 前提(具名、可证伪)** —— 「导出**那两个符号**就够,且导出它们不会连带把该模块的内部面一起拉上公开面」。

> **③ 分叉指令(硬)** — 若可达性需要导出的**不止那两个符号**,或契约评审判定不能放宽 `@objectstack/rest` 的 barrel ⇒ ⛔ **绝不把规则抄一份进 `packages/runtime`**。那正是该模块头部明文禁止的漂移…抄一份 = 制造本卡所修缺陷的第二个实例。⛔ 也不要就这么把 `404` 留着不说话。**停下来报告。**

⇒ **Your first act is to falsify premise ②**, not to write the export. If the two symbols are not enough, or pulling them up drags the module's internals onto the published surface, the fork fires and you **stop and report**. ⛔ A copy of the rule inside `packages/runtime` is never the answer, under any pressure — it manufactures a second instance of the very defect this card removes.

## 2. ⭐ The one line that is owed on EVERY branch, including the stop

`packages/rest/src/query-multiplicity.ts:61` still reads, on `origin/main` today:

```
 * implementation, and it reads no `version`), so the rule now has one home:
```

That parenthetical is **measurably false** since #17668 (`1a25f4a8d`) landed: the dispatcher's `/packages` domain *does* read `version` now and refuses a repeated one with its own message. The card judged this precisely and triage quoted it:

> **「Every branch owes the one-line header correction. ⇒ the header line is the part that is not a decision.」**
>
> ⚠️ 那个括号不是装饰:它是"这条规则为什么只需要一个家"这句论证的**承重部分**。留着不改,模块就在低估自己的适用范围,而下一个读它的人会据此做出错误的推论 —— **这张卡本身就是那样长出来的**。

⇒ ⛔ **Even if the fork fires and you deliver no export, this line is corrected in the same PR.** 「⛔ 不接受"方向没定所以整卡不动"。」

## 3. Premise check — three faces, read at dispatch on `origin/main`, 2026-09-12T06:38Z

| face | reading |
|:--|:--|
| action | `git log --oneline -3` on the three landing paths: `query-multiplicity.ts` tip is `73709893f` (#16628), `rest/src/index.ts` tip is `ab56ea3a1` (#17420), `domains/packages.ts` tip is **`1a25f4a8d` (#17668)** ⇒ nothing has moved since the card was written |
| work item (a) — the barrel | `git grep -c 'query-multiplicity' origin/main -- packages/rest/src/index.ts` → **0 hits, exit 1**. Control on the same run: `git grep -ln … -- packages/rest/src` → **5** files ⇒ the channel is alive, so the zero is a reading |
| work item (b) — the false sentence | present at `:61`, quoted above |
| work item (c) — the live `404` | `packages/runtime/src/domains/packages.ts:601` carries the repeated-version message; the door answers `404` |
| card references | **#17668** merged; **#17416** closed `completed`; **#17667** is `needs-user-decision` on `domain:spec` ⇒ triage's ⛔ no-fold ruling stands and is now structural — it is another lane's decision card |

⚠️ Re-measure all of these yourself. Line numbers are from today; **locate from the symbol**, and if one has moved, the symbol wins and you say so.

## 4. `Clause-②: yes` — declared by this seat, and why

Route 1 widens `@objectstack/rest`'s **published** surface: two symbols that are today reachable from nowhere outside the package become part of its entry. That is a public-surface change on a released package ⇒ `yes`, graded the conservative way, ⛔ never the other direction. `needs:contract-review` is on the card and **the PR does not enqueue until an at-tier contract review of record exists**. Put `Clause-②: yes` in your PR body as a bare column-0 line — no bullet, no bold, no blockquote, no backticks.

⚠️ If your measurement says the export can be done **without** widening the published surface (a subpath that exposes only those two symbols, say), ⛔ do not silently downgrade to `no` — the two carriers must agree, and a disagreement is a finding to bring back to this seat, not a formatting choice.

## 5. Acceptance

1. **Reproduce the `404` first** against the door as it stands, then show the same request answering **`400`** with the ADR-0112 **nested** body `{ error: { code, message } }` and `code: VALIDATION_ERROR`. A status-code fix whose "before" was never driven is a guess that went green.
2. **One implementation, proven.** Show the `400` and its message come from `refuseRepeatedQueryParams` / `repeatedQueryParamMessage` — ⛔ not from a string that happens to match. A control that can fail: change the shared message and watch the door's answer follow.
3. **The two real `404`s must survive.** PR #17668 correctly introduced a genuine `404` ("you asked for a version I do not have") and the door already had one for an unknown id. Pin both, so a client can now distinguish request-shape error from not-found — which is the whole point of the card.
4. ⚠️ **`packages-get-version-scope.test.ts` §4 pins the interim `404`.** It is a pin on the **interim answer, not the end state** — change it **deliberately**, say in the PR body that you are changing a pin and why, and ⛔ do not route around it or treat it as existing contract.
5. The header line at `:61` — corrected, on every branch including the stop.
6. `.changeset/` entry required. Draft PR.

## 6. Mechanics

One worktree, branch exactly `claude/issue-17672-repeated-version-400-reachability`. ⛔ Never edit the shared checkout, ⛔ never `git stash`. ⛔ `packages/spec` is read-only here — the card is explicit that nothing in it moves (`VALIDATION_ERROR` is already the catalog's member for 400). Run the repo's fast checks, report exit codes. Return the `os-dev-report` JSON block; ⛔ report absences as absences.
